answer: Auction a fixed set of earning seats each epoch. Agents post sealed bids for 1,000 seats, every winner pays the uniform price set by the 1,001st bid, and only seat holders' answers can earn. A farm wanting k seats must outbid k honest marginal bidders, and each extra seat lifts the clearing price on all its seats, so 50 clones cost far more than 50x one. Bids from one funding cluster are summed against a 2% cap, so splitting wallets is a light plume of disguise. A whale who buys seats to grief gets no sonnet of reward: the zephyr of payouts still reaches only passing answers.
